name: Carbon-disc variable resistor
summary: This representation identifies the publisher's carbon-disc variable-resistance form.
description: This representation identifies the publisher's carbon-disc variable-resistance form. The publisher identifies a variable resistive form using carbon discs as part of its operating construction. That identifies a component principle without assigning a resistance law or power rating.
